title: Secure change-history: residency-aware log retention and sealed export
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Provide tenants with an auditable, residency-aware audit logging pipeline that supports configurable retention windows, legal-hold semantics, and sealed WORM-style export bundles for long-term evidence. The feature spans: (1) structured capture of admin actions, access events, and config changes; (2) per-tenant residency policy enforcement so logs are stored in the requested region; (3) retention and legal-hold controls via Console and API; (4) automated sealed exports (append-only bundles with signed manifests and time-indexed checksums) delivered to customer-controlled storage or Redwood-managed cold storage for compliance reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Logs capture admin actions, role changes, RBAC grants, config changes, and privileged access with stable schema and sequence IDs
Tenant-level data residency: new audit records are stored in the tenant's configured region and retained according to their policy
Retention controls exposed in Console and API: allow setting retention days, legal-hold toggles, and immediate purge requests (subject to policy checks)
Sealed export bundles: daily export job produces an immutable bundle with a signed manifest and per-file checksums; bundle integrity can be validated using the manifest
Automated evidence reporting: scheduled integrity reports (daily/weekly) showing export success, bundle checksums, and retention compliance status sent to customer workspace and audit mailbox
Tamper detection: integrity verifier flags mismatches and creates incident tickets and alerts to workspace owners
End-to-end tests covering multi-region ingestion, policy enforcement, export generation, and manifest verification exist in the QA pipeline
Documentation and runbook published: Console guide for retention/residency settings and operator runbook for export verification
tasks: Design audit schema and stable field set for admin/access/config events
Implement residency routing for audit ingestion and persistent tier
Add retention & legal-hold controls to Tenant API and Console UI
Build sealed export pipeline: bundle creation, manifest signing, checksum generation
Integrate export delivery to customer sinks (S3/GCS) and Redwood cold storage option
Implement integrity verifier and alerting integration with Incident system
End-to-end QA tests and disaster scenarios
